neighbours.label: a function word that is a typo for another word ('or' for 'of', 'every' for 'ever', 'if' for 'is')
fire: The kids loved the first chapter or the book and begged for more.
It was the coldest winter we have every had in this valley.
My only worry if that the train will be late again tonight.
He felt a sudden wave or panic when the lights went out.
Most or the guests left before the band started playing.
This is the friendliest hotel I have every stayed in abroad.
She added a pinch or salt and stirred the soup slowly.
The main problem if that nobody answers the phone after five.
quiet: The kids loved the opening pages of the story and begged for more.
It was the coldest winter anyone could remember in this valley.
My only worry is that the bus will be late again tonight.
He felt a sudden rush of fear when the power went out.
Many of the visitors went home before the music started.
This is the nicest guesthouse I have ever booked abroad.
She added some pepper or chilli and stirred the stew slowly.
The real issue is that the office never replies after five.

notes: card: peaks on ' or' x14 in slots that need 'of' ('feelings or nervousness', 'a layer or extra sweetness'), ' every' for 'ever', ' if' for 'is'. Probe: typo versions 0.69/1.02, corrected versions ~0.01. Near misses are the corrected sentences with different wording.
